items.prompt: Write a jq filter that lists the ids of items with no labels, given bd's export.
Make the fixture write labels the way bd 1.3.1 does.
items.answer: Pass null, not [], when an item has no labels.

items.prompt: What does .labels | index("x") do on null?
items.answer: It fails: index needs a string or an array.

items.prompt: Why default with // rather than with if?
items.answer: // replaces null and false in one step and reads as the default it is.

items.prompt: Why does the image test run the real bd as well?
items.answer: A fixture can drift from the tool; only the real output catches that.

items.prompt: What if bd started printing [] instead?
items.answer: Every reader still works, because // [] leaves [] alone; the fixture test would need updating to match.

items.prompt: When is defaulting with // the wrong fix?
items.answer: When null means something different from empty, for example unknown versus none.
